answer: A new identity starts with zero reputation and must earn it through a chain of attested jobs vouched by distinct established peers, like boats queuing at a jetty where only vessels with a real cargo history may dock. Each completed task adds a small, time-stamped signal to its record, and a Sybil swarm cannot fake that history without doing the work itself. The cost is time and real effort per identity, so a haven built on earned history prices out mass forgery.
